header: Consumed by the box roll: this manifest records every file of the canonical tree (75-drama-song-ad-factory/) against its packaged copy, and onboarding is canonical per references/parity-contract.md.
notes: One record per file: every path in the union of both trees, ordered differing, one-sided, then identical.
A side that does not carry the file has sha256 null.
scripts/core/ is byte-identical across both sides at these shas (496 files, diff -r exit 0), so no control-layer fix exists on one side only.
No file classified packaged-ahead, so the upstream step of this reconciliation copied nothing; this manifest is the only content of the branch.

files.reason: Two parallel release logs on different version series (canonical v2.9.x, packaged v2.7.x); the packaged log carries the 2026-10-10 character-bible release note the canonical log never listed, while the fix itself (scripts/core/character_bible/) is byte-identical on both sides, so nothing functional is missing; the SPEC standing rule reserves every CHANGELOG edit to the wave-1 batch workflow.
Distribution-specific core-update policy; the shared parity rules already live in references/parity-contract.md, and the canonical side is newer (871eab9 2026-10-11 vs 688ad8f 2026-10-08).
Canonical-only: onboarding ships it and the packaged copy does not; parity-contract.md allows distribution material outside scripts/core/, so it is not copied into the package.

Distribution-specific install contract (canonical install.sh / OPENCLAW skills dir vs the packaged bundled-skills mechanism); no packaged-only fix inside it, and the canonical side is newer (65a7d7c 2026-10-13 vs 6e5730e 2026-10-08).
Distribution-specific operating instructions; the canonical side carries the later studio-order work and is newer (8b94b93 2026-10-13 vs 55a3196 2026-10-11).
Canonical-only: onboarding ships it and the packaged copy does not; parity-contract.md allows distribution material outside scripts/core/, so it is not copied into the package.

Same prerequisites under distribution-specific ids (canonical skill-* helpers vs packaged helper-* helpers); both sides carry python-mediapipe and face-landmarker-model, and the canonical side is newer (1f5e3ea 2026-10-11 vs 2f87448 2026-10-09).
Ownership rule: wave-1 units SWI-001 (canonical SKILL.md) and SWI-003 (packaged SKILL.md) own it; SWI-006 records the drift and edits nothing here.
